text.au: Polls open across the US in midterm elections that will decide which party controls Congress for the rest of Trump's second term. In Queensland, the Mater closes pathology labs at its Brisbane and Springfield hospitals amid a possible formaldehyde exposure investigation, affecting about 400 staff. Australia seeks to change its visa deal with the UK after an influx of Britons, and the RBA's fifth rate hike adds pressure on Labor.
text.europe: A second apparent cyber-attack in weeks hits Europe's supermarket fridges and freezers, raising questions about who is responsible and why. Western officials say UK and European peacekeepers in Ukraine could fire back at Russians, while Americans vote in midterms seen as a referendum on Trump. Zelenskyy makes an unexpected visit to Berlin for talks with Merz and calls Russian attacks on US election day telling.
text.international: Americans vote in midterm elections that many see as a referendum on Trump, with Republican control of the Senate and House at stake. Western officials say UK and European peacekeepers in Ukraine could fire back at Russians, and Zelenskyy makes an unexpected visit to Berlin for talks with Merz. He calls Russian attacks on US election day telling, while Denmark pushes for an EU ban on fast-growing 'turbo chickens'.
